question: Washing soda is _________ in nature.
solution:
The correct answer is __**basic**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Washing soda**, also known as **sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)**, is a chemical compound that is **basic** in nature.
 
• It is commonly used in laundry detergents and cleaning products due to its ability to remove dirt and grease.
 
• Washing soda is an alkaline substance, which means it has a high pH level and can neutralize acids.
 
• It is also used in various industrial processes, such as glass manufacturing and water treatment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium carbonate** should be handled with care as it can **cause irritation to the skin, eyes, and respiratory system**.
 
• In addition to its cleaning properties, washing soda is also used in cooking, particularly in the preparation of certain types of noodles and pretzels.
 
• It is important to store washing soda in a dry place as it can absorb moisture from the air and form clumps.
 
• Washing soda can be used as an eco-friendly alternative to many harsh chemical cleaners.
